description: This file contains the code-behind logic for the EditMCQ web page in an online examination system. It manages UI interactions such as course selection based on semester and year, navigation buttons for homepage, profile, leaderboard, logout, and session handling. It is primarily responsible for populating course selections and handling user actions on the page.
